name: Kosmos-613
about: Kosmos-613 (1973-096A), a crewed vehicle (7K-T), launched 1973 Nov 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1973 Dec 31), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
